name: John Holt
source: Figures are in absolute naira. The audited statement is presented in N millions; values were scaled by 1,000,000 so the terminal renders them at the same magnitude as every other Nigerian board file. John Holt Plc consolidated statement of financial position for the year ended 30 September 2025 (N millions) for FY2025 and the audited FY2024 comparative; FY2023 to FY2020 rows retained from the NGX filing library. The stored total assets row carried 1,028 and 175 against FY2024 and FY2023; the audited FY2024 total assets are 8,873, so that cell was corrected to the audited figure and the unreconcilable FY2023 cell cleared.
